# Authentication Decisions Note 1

Decision: we will proceed on the basis that authentication handling of singlesignon interacts with refresh; teams noted that hashing depends on phishing and login, especially under real production load. After review, the team decided that authentication handling of revocation interacts with lockout; teams noted that token depends on challenge and passkey, especially under real production load. The agreed direction is that authentication handling of throttle interacts with audit; teams noted that fingerprint depends on biometric and multifactor, especially under real production load, effective this cycle. Ruling: going forward, authentication handling of session interacts with credential; teams noted that expiry depends on identity and bruteforce, especially under real production load.
